subject: MAP cadence: security sprint sync — evidence & pen test schedule
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Zhao <amy.zhao@acmetech.com>, John Patel <john.patel@acmetech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP cadence: security sprint sync — evidence & pen test schedule

Hi Amy / John —

Following our MAP checklist for SOC 2 and the upcoming pen test, sharing the weekly status and owners. Please review and flag any gaps before our Friday checkpoint. I attached an updated evidence tracker (MAP_Acme_evidence_tracker_v2.xlsx) and the pen test scope PDF.

Summary (high priority first):
- SOC 2 evidence bundle (owner: Monica) — items outstanding: user access matrix, audit log manifest, DPA redlines. Target: 2027-08-25.
- Pen test scheduling (owner: Amy) — vendor confirmed availability week of 9/6; need final scope approval by 8/24.
- Audit logs retention and export (owner: Rishi) — confirm retention policy and provide export sample for Acme. Target: 8/22.
- DPA signature follow-ups (owner: Neha) — coordinate in-parallel with legal; confirm if a customer-signed addendum is required. Target: 8/26.

Action items table (quick):
1) Monica: upload missing SOC 2 artifacts to Drive folder + mark status in tracker. (Due: 8/25)
2) Rishi: produce 7-day audit log export sample and retention doc (Due: 8/22)
3) Amy: confirm final pen test scope acceptance or requests for change (Due: 8/24)
4) Neha: list DPA open clauses and propose language for addendum (Due: 8/26)

Meeting cadence: weekly 30m sync Fridays 10:00 PT — next is 2027-08-20. If any owner needs to shift dates, call it out here.

Attachments: MAP_Acme_evidence_tracker_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), pen_test_scope_acme_2027.pdf (PDF stub)

Thanks —
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Amy Zhao <amy.zhao@acmetech.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: John Patel <john.patel@acmetech.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP cadence: security sprint sync — evidence & pen test schedule

Thanks Grace — appreciate the clear breakdown. Quick updates from Acme: 

- Pen test: vendor (SectraSecurity) is available 9/6–9/10. We reviewed the draft scope and have two minor asks: include external-config scan and a brief focus on tokenization endpoints. We'll confirm final scope by 8/23 after an internal review.
- Audit log sample: we can accept a 7-day export first; would prefer to see a sample schema and a CSV export from your staging environment.
- DPA: legal is fine with the main terms but wants to confirm retention window and subprocessor list before signing.

I'll aim to have the scope sign-off by Monday (8/23). If Rishi can post the export sample to the Drive link you shared, that will speed things up.

Best,
Amy
Amy Zhao
Head of IT Security, Acme Tech
amy.zhao@acmetech.com | +1 (212) 555-0104

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP cadence: security sprint sync — evidence & pen test schedule

Thanks — quick technical clarifications and commits from our side.

1) Audit logs: Redwood's default retention for production write-ahead logs is 90 days; we can provide a 7-day export extraction from the staging cluster with redacted PII. I'll produce a CSV sample (fields: timestamp, user_id_hash, action, resource, request_id) and drop it to the Drive folder by EOD 8/19.

2) Export mechanics: I'll include a short README on the export process and a script snippet so Acme can reproduce locally.

3) Pen test endpoints: internal note — tokenization endpoints are behind the gateway and require scoped creds; we should include those in the vendor access brief. Monica, please add that to the pen_test_scope_acme_2027.pdf in the Drive.

4) SOC 2 artifacts: I'm picking up the audit log manifest (partial) and will sync with Monica on the access matrix.

Attachments: audit_log_export_sample_staging.csv (stub) — uploaded to Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPAcme

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Platform Security, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0147

Thanks all — short follow-up to confirm commitments and next steps.

- Rishi: appreciate the export pledge — having the CSV + README by 8/19 is perfect.

I'll send the calendar invite for the 8/20 checkpoint; if anyone needs to reschedule, reply-all with availability.

Best,
Grace
